how: Each harness driven in a PTY (120x40) by the end-to-end deck against the fake model; keys and pastes written as the person would; each state read with `screenText`: `rows` holds the rows that show anything, `bright` the rows whose dim cells blank some of their text (`screenText`'s bright rows), `cursor` the cursor. The box was cleared between states with repeated Ctrl-U and Backspace; the state 12 onward come after one turn, 14 to 17 while a turn is held mid-flight.
